doc: After a question and ~10 s of silence: exactly one gentle re-ask, in different words, then silence.
agent_turns: Hi Jordan, I'm here to help with your claim. Are you and everyone else in a safe place right now?

When you have a moment, could you turn on your camera so I can see the damage to your vehicle?
